tests.name: WorkflowResult_TerminalPaths_ExposeOutcomeOrigin
tests.description: Every modeled terminal engine path distinguishes automated, repaired, timeout, and human resolution origins without changing final-status semantics.
tests.arrange: Script engine activities and human responses for each modeled terminal path.
tests.assert: WorkflowResult contains the expected final_status and outcome_origin pair.

tests.name: BuildRunReport_WithRetries_PreservesOrderedAttemptsAndUsage
tests.description: A report contains each retry once in sequence and sums independently available ATIF metrics without estimating cost.
tests.arrange: Create terminal metadata and out-of-order attempt observations with partial usage and ATIF references.
tests.assert: Attempts are ordered exactly once, valid metric totals are summed, unavailable cost stays unavailable, and ATIF paths remain referenced.

tests.name: BuildRunReport_WithInvalidMetadata_RejectsInvalidDocument
tests.description: Required metadata, identity isolation, enums, and schema versions are validated while an empty attempt ledger remains valid.
tests.arrange: Create valid and invalid report inputs including missing metadata, mismatched attempt identity, and empty attempts.
tests.assert: Valid empty-ledger input succeeds and each invalid contract fails before publication.

tests.name: PublishRunReport_RepeatedOrInterrupted_IsAtomicAndIdempotent
tests.description: Validated reports publish to a deterministic safe path via atomic replacement and interrupted publication exposes no partial final file.
tests.arrange: Use unsafe workflow/run identifiers, repeat publication, and inject replacement failure in a temporary report root.
tests.assert: One schema-valid final report exists per run, traversal is impossible, and failed temporary publication leaves no partial final or temporary file.

tests.name: AggregateRunReports_WithMixedCandidates_PublishesAuditableOperands
tests.description: Aggregation filters an explicit UTC window, validates compatibility, deduplicates run identity, and publishes formula operands and traceability.
tests.arrange: Create final reports spanning all origins plus malformed, incompatible, duplicate, temporary, and out-of-window candidates.
tests.act: Aggregate the explicit root and inclusive-start/exclusive-end UTC window.
tests.assert: Counts, exclusions, observations, manual interventions, numerator, denominator, and automated_pass_rate_v1 are reproducible and retries do not inflate the denominator.

tests.name: AggregateRunReports_WithEmptySample_ReturnsNullRate
tests.description: An empty compatible sample still publishes the formula and zero operands without dividing by zero.
tests.arrange: Use a report root with no compatible in-window final reports.
tests.act: Aggregate the explicit UTC window and atomically publish the snapshot.
tests.assert: Numerator and denominator are zero, success_rate is null, counts are empty, and the aggregate is schema-valid.

tests.name: PublishRunReportActivity_WithTerminalResult_WritesRunScopedReport
tests.description: A side-effecting Activity derives Cadence workflow/run identity and publishes the terminal report beneath the configured report root.
tests.arrange: Provide Activity runtime identity, a terminal workflow result, story path, and temporary report root.
tests.assert: The Activity returns the final run-scoped report path and the schema-versioned report exists there.

tests.name: StoryAnalysisWorkflow_OnTerminalResult_PublishesBeforeCompletion
tests.description: The workflow schedules report publication after its engine reaches a modeled terminal state and exposes report_path only after publication succeeds.
tests.arrange: Stub skill Activities and the publication Activity for an automated-pass workflow.
tests.act: Run StoryAnalysisWorkflow with an explicit report root.
tests.assert: Publication receives terminal evidence and the returned result and status query expose its report_path.

tests.name: StoryAnalysisWorkflow_WhenPublicationFails_DoesNotClaimReportedCompletion
tests.description: A publication failure fails completion rather than returning a terminal result containing an unpublished report path.
tests.arrange: Complete domain processing and make the report publication Activity fail.
tests.assert: The workflow raises the publication failure and get_status has no report_path.

tests.name: SkillActivityOutput_EachAttempt_CarriesTelemetryObservation
tests.description: Each common Skill Activity execution returns retry-safe identity, artifacts, invocation profile, outcome, duration, and normalized ATIF usage.
tests.arrange: Execute successful and failed harness attempts with Cadence Activity identity and partial ATIF metrics.
tests.assert: Every executed attempt has one isolated immutable observation without raw trajectory content.

tests.name: ReportSchemas_CompleteDocumentsValidateAndInvalidDocumentsFail
tests.description: Standalone V1 report and aggregate JSON Schemas enforce required fields, enums, versions, numeric bounds, and nested observations.
tests.arrange: Prepare complete and structurally invalid report and aggregate documents.
tests.act: Validate each document against its workflow-owned schema.
tests.assert: Complete documents pass and invalid documents fail before publication.

tests.name: AggregationCLI_WithExplicitWindow_RendersPublishedSnapshot
tests.description: The operator boundary accepts an explicit report root and UTC window and publishes aggregation output without recomputing presentation-only values.
tests.arrange: Create visible reports and invoke the aggregation CLI with explicit arguments.
tests.assert: Output includes formula operands, counts, exclusions, observations, and aggregate path.
